title: 第十四章追杀第十五章清虚老道
slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: 小月宗山门外百丈处，已有众多尸体。
从穿着上看，这些人要么是小月宗的杂役弟子，要么是外门弟子。
江离这才明白，怪不得那名台海宗的修士没有对自己出手，原来是因为自己不配。
截杀他们这些人的，另有布置。
从这一点上江离也看出来了，台海宗压根就没想放过任何人，是要对小月宗赶尽杀绝。
“老王！”
在那一片尸体之中，江离看到了一个熟悉的人。
还在杂役班房的时候江离便认识了此人，他是杂役弟子中的老人，平时负责给杂役弟子做饭。
老王为人和善，在那群杂役弟子中也是年纪最大的一个。
他来小月宗倒不是为了修仙，只是因为小月宗的杂役弟子每个月有三两银子，他为了让妻女过上好日子才选择来的小月宗。
因此，即便他获得了修仙功法，也从未认真修炼过，导致他直到现在还停留在炼气一层。
却没想到最后竟倒在了这里。
此时老王其实并没有死，只是身子已经被人斩成了两半，倒在血泊之中。
喉咙之中不断发出“嗬嗬”的痛苦呻吟。
江离心中不忍，却也知道此时并非是发善心的时候。
他都不确定自己是否能活下去，更别说去救老王了。
只能撇过头，向另一个方向逃跑。
修仙界，根本容不下老王这样的人存在。
赵天奇，炼气期五层修为。
若是放在小宗门中，赵天奇这样的修为已足够成为宗门之中的内门弟子。
奈何，他选择了台海宗。
没办法，谁让台海宗是沧澜州最大的宗门。
所以他现在在台海宗中也不过是一名普通的外门弟子。
但只要完成这次任务，回到台海宗，便是大功一件，便会获得破格成为台海宗内门弟子的机会。
赵天奇这次的任务是负责截杀那些，想要逃离小月宗的杂役弟子和外门弟子。
起初他对此还有些兴趣，直至连杀了几个连反抗都不会的杂役弟子之后，他便开始觉得有些无聊了。
可就在刚才，一名小月宗的外门弟子的出现才让他提起了一些兴趣。
别看此人只是炼气三层，竟还有些手段。
非但用计反杀了一名台海宗外门弟子，还在他和另一名台海宗的外门弟子的共同截杀下坚持到了现在。
不过此人已经受了重伤，难以再翻起什么大浪了。
content_en:
There were many corpses a hundred feet outside the gate of Xiaoyue Zong Mountain.
Judging from their clothes, these people were either handyman disciples of Xiaoyue Sect or outer disciples.
Only then did Jiang Li realize that no wonder the monk from the Taihai Sect didn't take action against him. It turned out to be because he was unworthy.
Those who intercepted and killed these people had other plans.
From this point, Jiang Li could also see that Taihai Sect had no intention of letting anyone go, and wanted to kill Xiaoyue Sect completely.
"Old Wang!"
Among the corpses, Jiang Li saw a familiar person.
Jiang Li met this person when he was still in the handyman class. He was an old man among the handyman disciples, and he was usually responsible for cooking for the handyman disciples.
Lao Wang is a kind-hearted person and is also the oldest among the group of handyman disciples.
He came to Xiaoyue Sect not to cultivate immortality, but because the handyman disciples of Xiaoyue Sect had three taels of silver every month. He chose to come to Xiaoyue Sect in order to let his wife and daughter live a good life.
Therefore, even though he obtained the immortal cultivation technique, he never practiced it seriously, causing him to still stay at the first level of Qi refining until now.
But he didn't expect to fall here in the end.
At this time, Lao Wang was not actually dead, but his body had been cut in half and he fell in a pool of blood.
Painful moans of "ho ho" kept coming from his throat.
Jiang Li couldn't bear it, but he also knew that this was not the time to show kindness.
He was not sure whether he could survive, let alone save Lao Wang.
He could only turn his head and run away in the other direction.
In the world of immortality, there is simply no room for people like Lao Wang to exist.
…
Zhao Tianqi is at the fifth level of Qi refining stage.
If placed in a small sect, Zhao Tianqi's cultivation level is enough to become an inner disciple of the sect.
However, he chose Taihai Sect.
There is no way, who makes Taihai Sect the largest sect in Canglan Prefecture.
So now he is just an ordinary outer disciple in Taihai Sect.
But as long as you complete this mission and return to Taihai Sect, it will be a great achievement, and you will have the opportunity to become an inner disciple of Taihai Sect.
Zhao Tianqi's mission this time was to intercept and kill the handyman disciples and outer disciples who wanted to escape Xiaoyue Sect.
At first he was somewhat interested in it, but after killing several handyman disciples who couldn't even resist, he began to feel a little bored.
But just now, the appearance of an outer disciple of Xiaoyue Sect made him a little more interested.
Even though this person is only at the third level of Qi Refining, he actually has some skills.
Not only did he use a trick to kill an outer disciple of the Taihai Sect, but he also managed to survive until now under the joint interception and killing of him and another outer disciple of the Taihai Sect.
However, this person has been seriously injured and it is difficult to make any big waves again.
